findings.finding: Beat induction enables humans to infer a regular pulse from sound patterns and synchronize their physical movements to it.
findings.quote: Beat induction is the process in which a regular isochronous pulse is activated while one listens to music

findings.finding: Sensorimotor synchronization coordinates rhythmic movements with external auditory rhythms.
findings.quote: Sensorimotor synchronization (SMS) is the coordination of rhythmic movement with an external rhythm, ranging from finger tapping in time with a metronome to musical ensemble performance.

principle: Research shows that humans synchronize their physical movements with external auditory rhythms through cortical and neural mechanisms that link beat perception directly to predictive sensorimotor synchronization.
for_the_teacher: Ensure learners practice physical movements alongside clear musical beats to support sensorimotor synchronization.
